issues.description: The UML in the problem statement marks getTotalNumberOfStudents() as public, but the reference solution declares it as protected. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the expected accessibility of the method and may affect how they implement or test the method (the UML and task text suggest a public API method).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Either update the solution to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents() as public (public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()) to match the UML and task description, or update the problem statement/UML to indicate protected if that was intended. Prefer making the method public so it matches the UML and task expectations.
